name: Rounded bowl
summary: Shallow hemispherical bowl with rounded sides curving inward to a slightly flattened convex base; red earthenware lightly burnished on interior and exterior; decorated on the exterior around the lip with a wide band painted in brown slip before firing; some whitish encrustations from burial. Early Yangshao culture, Banpo type. From the middle Yellow River valley region, Shaanxi province.
